Your AI works. Your data infrastructure does not.

A study of 6,100 enterprise decision-makers just revealed the real reason most AI deployments underperform — and it has nothing to do with the model.

1 in 5 workers lose an entire day every week manually moving data between systems that cannot communicate. Not building. Not strategizing. Just copying, reformatting, and reconciling information across disconnected tools.

Executives approved the AI budget expecting transformation. What they got was an intelligent layer sitting on top of broken plumbing.

The companies actually extracting ROI from AI did something different. They rebuilt their data pipelines and integration architecture first. They treated system connectivity as a strategic initiative, not an IT ticket.

The difference between AI-ready and AI-productive is not a better model. It is better infrastructure underneath.
